programmes.d: Veronica uncovers a secret organization on campus after she's accused of providing a fake ID to a student. Meanwhile, Aaron hires Keith to find out who's humiliating his wife.
Veronica and Keith investigate the kidnapping of a hip-hop heavyweight's daughter, and Logan prepares for his mother's memorial following her apparent suicide.
Veronica is pitted against her father after her favorite teacher is accused of sexual harassment. Meanwhile, Logan turns to Veronica to help uncover the truth about his mother.
Veronica tries to track down a friend's secret admirer and a Russian bride's estranged fiancé. Meanwhile, Veronica discovers that Lynn Echolls' credit card has been used.
Veronica tries to track down a kidnapped mascot. Meanwhile, Veronica's suspicions about the Kane family are rekindled. Later, Veronica's relationship with Deputy Leo intensifies.
Veronica pursues a risky lead, and Logan finds Veronica's files of everyone connected to Lilly's death. Plus, a senior student hires Veronica to find her tormenter.
Veronica investigates bomb threats at Neptune High, Keith reveals who he has been secretly dating and Duncan confronts Veronica about her investigation into his sister's death.
Veronica stumbles onto a mystery that affects pets all over Neptune, and tensions mount in the Echolls family. Later, Weevil is arrested for breaking into the Kane residence.
Veronica helps a classmate being threatened by her boyfriend, and Keith searches for Duncan. Later, Veronica learns a disturbing fact about the night she was assaulted.
Veronica investigates her assault. Meanwhile, when one of Veronica and Wallace's stunts affects Alicia's job, Alicia confronts Keith. Later, Aaron hosts a party for Logan.
Veronica solves the mystery of who murdered her best friend, Lilly Kane--but she betrays someone she cares deeply about in the process.
Zoe tricks Jonah (Travis Van Winkle) into spilling a secret about Brick. Wade and Lemon each try to prove they know what is best for the new Rammer Jammer.
Rose (Mckaley Miller) and Max (Nicholas Podany) play matchmaker for Zoe. Rob Huebel (Childrens Hospital) guest stars as a potential love interest.
In the season finale, Zoe decides to visit New York, but a medical emergency on the plane forces her to complete the trip with an unexpected companion. The band Gloriana performs.
In the season premiere, after a summer in New York, Zoe is ready to move permanently, but first she must return to BlueBell. Lemon has a plan to help out Wade in front of Zoe.
Lavon and AnnaBeth invite Zoe and Joel (Josh Cooke) over for a quiet dinner, but when Lemon invites herself and Alabama's most eligible bachelor (Ryan Mcpartlin), things go awry.
Lemon finds herself in hot water. George finds himself needing medical attention during a tutoring session with Lynly (Antoinette Robertson), forcing him to call Zoe for help.
Lemon is blacklisted from the Junior League Halloween Masquerade party, but her Grandma Bettie (Maree Cheatham) helps out. Lavon has a surprise for his anniversary with AnnaBeth.

Amy learns that Ephram is going to be a regular fixture in her life now that he has moved in with Bright and Reid. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown, Nina and Jake attempt to move on with life.
Ephram begins giving piano lessons to a teen piano prodigy, but the music awakens difficult memories. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown advises a brain tumor patient and his wife.
Ephram reveals the true reason he returned to Everwood. Bright contemplates a sex-free relationship with Hannah after she tells him that she doesn't believe in premarital sex.
In hopes of mending Dr. Brown and Jake's friendship, Nina suggests the two men go to counseling together. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown tells Ephram that Amy may be seeing someone new.
Hannah's mother makes an unexpected visit to Everwood to tell Hannah that her father has passed away. Ephram is forced to watch Amy's relationship with Reid grow more serious.
